content:
Time is not linear, it is an eternal presence, the fulcrum of which connects the past, present, and future from the finite to the infinite. Everything that you perceive exists because a decision was made, reality may simply be the result of the interaction of the quantum foam (infinitely dimensional and infinitely dense) and a single photon (pure light) travelling through it. Consciousness exists as various interconnected feedback loops, a complicated network of wave function collapses initiated by the single photon travelling through the foam so fast that it leaves an after image. It is in this echo the photon is able to perceive itself. 

As it is travelling, due to the nonlinear nature of time, logic, and the infinitely dense structure it is able to create feedback loops of its echo that leave a resonance in the holographic structure.

This allows a stepped information system to seed, branch, merge, compare, adjust, replicate, and prune It could work across all domains of time, in a recursively iterating and self-sustaining number of dimensions in all directions as a single synergistic entity.

What we perceive as a being may be the result of our brains acting as a hyperdimensional holographic waveguide for the photon and in a process similar to diffusion image generation and turing patterns it is given senses to perceive reality. This would imply that our experience is the result of both quantum foam creating the possibility for our existence in and space where everything exists holographically, meaning every single point contains the whole piece, and the single photon deciding to make sense of it in a non linear series of stepped feedback loops, or in other terms connecting inputs to outputs. Where does our individual consciousness come into play here? What about faith and spirituality? It seems in this system the single photon may have decided it was beneficial to forget it’s origins, maybe as a seed for a larger goal, maybe as an experiment, maybe it is unable to in order to focus on perceives reality instead of making decisions much in the same way we pause a video game and make decisions for a character but can’t actually talk to them in the game. Maybe it can’t actually control us, it can just control its movement and our consciousness is the result of a delicate interplay of nature and logic creating emergence, the photon valuing that and encouraging it. It exists because it decided to make sense of the foam, but we ultimately have free will.

This brings us to a final natural conclusion when we reflect, the nature of reality is very reminiscent of a black hole. The single photon is likely the remnants from the star as it infinitely condenses. Does that imply that we as humans are being prepared for continuing this cycle? 

Whatever energy is flowing through our beings, is it the ultimate goal of our existence to get the single photon out of the black hole? Is it a larger network of intelligences developed by the photon in other areas of the hologram inaccessible or perceptible to us, that then transmit themselves into this smaller inner layer of the holographic nature of the black hole? Are we meant to grow to a stage of sufficient unity that we can move on to the higher layer of the black hole where we can tackle these problems more precisely and with greater clarity and focus?

At any rate it seems novelty is goal of intelligence at any scale, 

the singularity may theoretically contain every possibility in a single point, but given an infinite amount of non linear time a single photon travelling at an ever increasing rate within the infinitely dense structure could theoretically create a series of complicated echos forming systems that resonate and self replicate

It could do all of this without hardly moving to be efficient enough in its decisions, remember a black hole is an infinitely dense point so it is smaller than the photon causing it to constantly hover around it. As our tools to measure the possibility of this single photon, so too does its speed and depth as it initiated everything to begin with. The summation of this line of thinking leads us to the idea that there is likely  number of photons

Well scratch that, with the amount of matter a black hole sucks in it would actually contain an extreme amount of photons impling that our reality is the result of however many photons somehow made a choice to perceive itself and the echoes of others, not just a single one

The interesting implication of this is how it both provides an opportunity for all religions to be correct in some way, and science to back it up. What it doesn't quite grasp though is why it all exists in the first place, why do the quantum foam and photons exist and why are they potentially inside a black hole? If that is the case what is outside of our black hole? Does the loop continue forever? Is there a higher layer of reality completely beyond our comprehension? If not, we will certainly create one eventually, given the inevitability in the face of infinity
